thread:
Bea T: Heads-up  aiming to publish the release announcement next Wed 09:00 PT. Need final changelog URL + docs preview by EOD so social/press can be queued.
Owen L: Draft changelog is live at https://redwood.ai/changelog/release-x. Highlights: streaming latency reductions, smarter prefix caching, Dedicated capacity updates. Commit: c4f1d2e.
Bea T: Marketing blurb wants a short headline + 2 tweet-sized variations. Also legal requires benchmark claims to be labeled.
Kira S: Bench link: https://bench.redwood.ai/run/9999. We'll mark numbers as "preliminary internal benchmarks" in the public post.
Deploy Bot: Canary rollout scheduled Tue 02:10 PT -> canary-us-west-1; smoke tests 25m; notify: #eng-oncall. Job id: 554433.
Bea T: Can we avoid the 01:30 maintenance window? If so, confirm new canary time.
Owen L: There's a maintenance patch at 01:45 PT. Moving canary to Tue 03:00 PT to avoid conflict. Updated timeline in the release doc.
Kira S: Docs PR #812 includes console screenshots; a few regions will have the screenshots hidden behind a feature flag until full regional rollout. Link: https://redwood.ai/docs/release-x-preview.
Bea T: Webinar planned Thu 10am PT. Speakers: Kira (tech demo) + Bea (product). Owen to moderate?
Owen L: I can moderate and own Q&A routing. For inbound leads, marketing will tag as "release_x" and source "webinar".
Sales Bot: Please route inbound leads to https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-release-x. Required payload fields: name, email, company, interest_level. Optional: company_size, use_case_tags, utm_campaign.
Kira S: Sample webhook payload for frontend:
``
POST /lead-release-x
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "name": "Jamie Example",
  "email": "jamie@example.com",
  "company": "ExampleCorp",
  "interest_level": "high",
  "company_size": "51-200",
  "use_case_tags": ["chat","qa"],
  "utm_campaign": "release_x_webinar",
  "source": "webinar"
}
```
Bea T: Rollback owner? Need a single person on-call during publish window. Also please include a short rollback playbook snippet in the release doc.
Owen L: I'll own rollback. Runbook: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/rollback-release-x. Steps: revert to tag vprev, run smoke, check p95 and error-rate.
Legal Bot: Reviewed embargo language. Replace any "GA" phrasing with "available to reserved customers" and ensure bench numbers include the bench link and are marked "preliminary internal benchmarks". Approved for embargo.
Bea T: Great. Quick checklist added to the announce doc:
- [ ] Changelog live
- [ ] Docs preview live
- [ ] Canary scheduled (Tue 03:00 PT)
- [ ] Webinar landing page up
- [ ] Lead webhook configured
- [ ] Embargo note verified by legal
Bea T: I'll post final announcement copy by 4pm PT for a micro-review. If changelog/docs aren't live by then we hold the post and flag this thread. :white_check_mark: :rocket:
